title_zh: 议价权的账单，和那个“没人要工具”的空白
title_en: The Bill for Bargaining Power, and the Gap Where Nobody Wants a Tool
desc_zh: 我们读完评论区后，把本周三个候选方向全部否掉了。为什么“没人想要工具”比“没人做过”更值得说。
desc_en: After reading the comment sections, we killed all three of this week's candidate directions. Why "nobody wants a tool" matters more than "nobody has built it".
